protocol.propagation: actual full contextual factual sentences; never mechanically extract a bare entity or scalar
protocol.rewrite_inputs: current self-contained question, original query, previous questions and complete candidate answer sentences; no gold answers or support annotations
protocol.rewrite_output: one self-contained retrieval question, or the exact original question if no safe useful rewrite exists
protocol.rewrite_gate: previous complete candidate answers are optional context; explicit missing information must not become a guessed binding
protocol.final_input: unchanged original Top10 plus generated auxiliary questions and complete answers, same frozen placement and final reader
protocol.comparison: historical S02 is a descriptive reference; matched ideal-plan control required to isolate dual retrieval if selected
protocol.best_baseline_reference: historical references are reported offline and never enter generation inputs
protocol.selection_change: 12 fresh type-stratified random cases per dataset; retain previous8 per dataset
protocol.reference_plan_method: current Codex drafts from frozen original questions only, reviews and freezes before generation

cache_policy: reuse only identical full API payloads within the private pilot; per-condition histories remain isolated
